title: Find a Three-Product Combination
real_world_story: An e-commerce platform wants to recommend three products whose combined price exactly matches a customer's shopping budget.

real_world_connection.algorithm_represents: Finding three products whose prices add up to the target

problem_statement: Given an array of product prices and a target budget B, determine whether three different products have prices whose sum is exactly B. Return their original indices if such a combination exists; otherwise return -1 -1 -1.
task: Find three products whose combined price exactly matches the customer's budget.
input_format: The first line contains an integer N. The second line contains N integers representing product prices. The third line contains an integer B representing the target budget.
output_format: Print the original indices of three products whose prices sum to B. If no such combination exists, print -1 -1 -1.

examples.explanation: The products at indices 0, 1 and 4 cost 200, 500 and 1000, giving a total of exactly 1700.
No three different products have prices that sum to 2000.

expected_algorithm.name: Three Sum
expected_algorithm.reason: Sorting followed by a two-pointer search for each fixed product efficiently finds a three-product combination.

hint: Sort the prices while preserving original indices.
Fix one product at a time.
Use two pointers to search for the remaining two prices.
real_world_takeaway: Three-sum techniques can help recommendation systems identify suitable multi-product bundles.
